title: Sharp effective equidistribution of closed geodesics in compact hyperbolic surfaces
summary: We prove a sharp effective equidistribution theorem for closed geodesics on a compact hyperbolic surface. This is achieved by carefully analyzing the Selberg trace formula twisted by a Maass eigenfunction, which we refer to as Zelditch's trace formula, following Zelditch's observation that the geometric side can be expressed as a sum of period integrals of eigenfunctions on closed geodesics.
